summary_bullets: Scope lint-fix-loop non-per-job prompts to the embedded checks log instead of a global relevant-checks pass goal
Derive in-scope file lists and phase-gated optional pre-commit hints from the same 60k-byte log excerpt
Add harness cases 12–16 and extend per-job case 6 for prompt composition regressions
commit_message:
Scope lint-fix-loop prompts to checks log failures (#3386)

Non-per-job compose_prompt now uses log-scoped fix sentences, shared
checks_log_excerpt parsing, in-scope file bullets, and split anti-cascade
guidance. Optional pre-commit hints are display-only when the excerpt
phase is pre-commit. Tests cover truncation coupling and unsafe paths.
